proteins.summary: The hormone that clears glucose from the blood.

structure.label: the hormone
structure.sentence: The C-peptide is cut out. Two disulfide bridges join A to B, a third folds A.
structure.semantics: The folded insulin molecule: the A and B chains, joined by two disulfide bridges, with a third inside the A chain. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Nine residues, cut out of a precursor a hundred and twenty-five long.

structure.label: the hormone
structure.sentence: One bridge closes the ring. Neurophysin, its carrier, is cut away.
structure.semantics: The oxytocin nonapeptide, closed into a ring by its single disulfide bridge. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Made as three copies in a row, then cut into three identical tags.

structure.label: the tag
structure.sentence: One of the three. All three fold into the same tag.
structure.semantics: One folded ubiquitin molecule, the tag the precursor is cut into three of. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Cuts the cell walls of bacteria. In tears, saliva and milk.

structure.label: the enzyme
structure.sentence: Four disulfide bridges brace the cleft a cell wall has to fit into.
structure.semantics: The folded lysozyme molecule, with the four disulfide bridges that brace the cleft a cell wall binds in. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: A calcium sensor in rods and cones. It sets how fast lit rhodopsin is shut off.

structure.label: the sensor
structure.sentence: Two lobes of two EF-hands each; two of the four bind calcium.
structure.semantics: Recoverin, solved by X-ray at 2.2 Å: its helices folded into four EF-hands, two to a lobe. 196 of its 199 residues are placed. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Carries oxygen from the lungs. Sickle-cell disease is one base of this gene.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One beta chain. Hemoglobin is four: two like this, and two alpha.
structure.semantics: The folded beta-globin chain, one of the four chains of a haemoglobin molecule. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Holds oxygen in muscle. The first protein whose structure was ever solved.

structure.label: the fold
structure.sentence: Eight helices around one pocket. The globin fold.
structure.semantics: The folded myoglobin molecule, eight helices around the pocket that holds its oxygen. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Softens ligaments in pregnancy. Built like insulin, and cut the same way.

structure.label: the hormone
structure.sentence: The same architecture as insulin: two chains, three disulfide bridges.
structure.semantics: The folded relaxin molecule: the A and B chains, joined by two disulfide bridges, with a third inside the A chain. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Somatotropin. Drives growth in childhood and metabolism after it.

structure.label: the hormone
structure.sentence: A bundle of four helices, pinned by two disulfide bridges.
structure.semantics: The folded growth hormone molecule, a bundle of four helices pinned by two disulfide bridges. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: The tumour suppressor. Mutated in about half of all human cancers.

structure.label: the core
structure.sentence: The part that grips DNA. Most of the rest of p53 is disordered and has no structure.
structure.semantics: The folded DNA-binding core of p53. The rest of the protein, mostly disordered, is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: The largest human gene: over 2 million bases, 79 exons, 3,685 residues.

structure.label: the actin grip
structure.sentence: No structure exists for all 3,685 residues. This is the end that holds actin.
structure.semantics: The folded actin-binding end of dystrophin. The other three thousand residues are solved only in fragments, if at all, and are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Tells the kidneys to hold on to water. Cut from a precursor built like oxytocin.

structure.label: the hormone
structure.sentence: One bridge closes the ring. Neurophysin 2 and copeptin are cut away.
structure.semantics: The vasopressin nonapeptide, closed into a ring by its single disulfide bridge. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Raises blood sugar. Its precursor also holds GLP-1 and GLP-2, cut out in the gut.

structure.label: the hormone
structure.sentence: One of several hormones cut from proglucagon. No disulfide bridges.
structure.semantics: Glucagon, the 29-residue hormone cut from proglucagon, as it sits in its receptor. The other peptides cut from the precursor are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Cut into amyloid-beta, the peptide that builds up in the brain in Alzheimer disease.

structure.label: the E1 domain
structure.sentence: No structure exists for all 770 residues. This is its first folded domain.
structure.semantics: The E1 domain at the start of APP, held by six disulfide bridges. Amyloid-beta and the rest of the protein are solved only in pieces and are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: A chloride channel in lungs and gut. Faults in it cause cystic fibrosis.

structure.label: the channel
structure.sentence: Two halves, each a membrane domain and an ATP-binding domain.
structure.semantics: The folded CFTR channel: two halves that each cross the membrane six times and bind ATP. The regulatory region between them is too mobile to resolve and is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Made in the kidney. Tells bone marrow to make red blood cells.

structure.label: the hormone
structure.sentence: A bundle of four helices, braced by two disulfide bridges.
structure.semantics: The folded erythropoietin molecule, a bundle of four helices braced by two disulfide bridges. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Made by fat cells. Tells the brain how much energy the body has stored.

structure.label: the hormone
structure.sentence: A bundle of four helices, closed by one disulfide bridge.
structure.semantics: The folded leptin molecule, a bundle of four helices with one disulfide bridge. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: A signal of inflammation, and the target of drugs for arthritis.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the soluble form. TNF works as three of these.
structure.semantics: One folded chain of soluble TNF, one of the three identical chains of an active TNF trimer, with its one disulfide bridge. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Clears superoxide radicals from cells. Mutations in it cause an inherited form of ALS.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain. SOD1 works as a pair of these.
structure.semantics: One folded SOD1 chain, one of the two identical chains of the active enzyme, with its one disulfide bridge. Its copper and zinc are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: The enzyme in saliva that starts breaking starch down into sugar.

structure.label: the enzyme
structure.sentence: Five disulfide bridges. Starch is cut in a cleft between its domains.
structure.semantics: The folded salivary amylase, with its five disulfide bridges and the cleft where starch is cut. Its calcium and chloride are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Harmless in its normal fold. Misfolded, it causes prion diseases such as CJD.

structure.label: the fold
structure.sentence: The folded half. The first hundred residues have no fixed shape.
structure.semantics: The folded C-terminal half of the prion protein: three helices, a short sheet and one disulfide bridge. The flexible N-terminal half is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Restrains the calcium pump of heart muscle, until adrenaline releases it.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of five. A long helix crosses the membrane, a short one lies outside.
structure.semantics: One phospholamban chain from its pentamer, solved by NMR: a short helix in the cytoplasm and a long one that crosses the membrane. The other four chains are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: A calcium sensor of glial cells. Its level in blood marks brain injury and melanoma.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the pair, its two EF-hands holding calcium.
structure.semantics: One S100B chain from the calcium-bound pair, solved with a peptide of its receptor RAGE: four helices folded into two EF-hands. The other chain, its calcium and the peptide are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Made by the placenta to keep the corpus luteum alive. The pregnancy test detects it.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: hCG is two chains: this one, and the alpha it shares with LH, FSH and TSH.
structure.semantics: The beta chain of hCG as it binds its receptor, solved by cryo-EM with the receptor, the alpha chain and a G protein, none of which are drawn. Six disulfide bridges hold it; its disordered C-terminal tail is not placed. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Stored in platelets, cut into CTAP-III, beta-thromboglobulin and the chemokine NAP-2.

structure.label: the chemokine
structure.sentence: CTAP-III, one of the forms it is cut into: a sheet, a helix, two bridges.
structure.semantics: CTAP-III, residues 44 to 128, one of the forms the chain is cut into, solved by X-ray at 1.93 Å: a sheet and a C-terminal helix, with two disulfide bridges. 81 of the 94 residues after the signal peptide are placed; the polyvinylsulfonate it was solved with is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Releases IGF by cleaving IGFBP-4 and -5. Measured in first-trimester screening.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of two, as it circulates in pregnancy bound to proMBP.
structure.semantics: One PAPP-A chain from its pregnancy form, two PAPP-A chains bound to two of proMBP, solved by cryo-EM at 3.6 Å. 1,484 of its 1,546 residues are placed, with 36 disulfide bridges. Its zinc and the other three chains are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Blocks cathepsins inside cells. Losing it causes Unverricht–Lundborg epilepsy.

structure.label: the inhibitor
structure.sentence: The cystatin fold: a five-stranded sheet wrapped round one long helix.
structure.semantics: One cystatin B chain, solved by X-ray at 1.8 Å: a long helix held in a curved sheet of five strands. 91 of its 98 residues are placed; the crystal's other nine chains are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Helps melanocytes make the dark pigment eumelanin. Faults in it cause albinism, OCA3.

structure.label: the enzyme
structure.sentence: The part inside the melanosome; its membrane helix and tail are not drawn.
structure.semantics: The part of TYRP1 inside the melanosome, solved by X-ray at 2.2 Å, with seven disulfide bridges. Its zinc ions, sugars and the tyrosine analogue it was solved with are not drawn, nor its membrane helix and tail, residues 472 to 537, which the crystal did not hold. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: The scaffold T4 and T3 are made on. Stored in the thyroid as colloid.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the dimer: a string of repeats and a cholinesterase-like end.
structure.semantics: One chain of the thyroglobulin dimer, solved by cryo-EM at 3.2 Å: a string of repeated domains ending in a cholinesterase-like one, with 57 disulfide bridges. 2,483 of its 2,749 residues are placed; its sugars and the other chain are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Made in the kidney and shed into urine, where its filaments trap bacteria.

structure.label: the ZP domain
structure.sentence: The ZP domain, which joins chains into filaments. The rest is not drawn.
structure.semantics: The ZP domain of uromodulin, residues 329 to 580, from filaments purified from urine and solved by cryo-EM at 3.6 Å, with four disulfide bridges. The rest of the chain, the filament's other chains and its sugars are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: On the sperm's head: it binds Juno on the egg, the step that makes them one.

structure.label: the ectodomain
structure.sentence: The part outside the sperm. Its membrane helix and tail are not drawn.
structure.semantics: The part of IZUMO1 outside the sperm, residues 22 to 255, solved by X-ray at 2.1 Å with five disulfide bridges. 234 of the 329 residues after the signal peptide are placed; the membrane helix and the tail inside are in no entry, and its one sugar is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: The sperm tail's own glycolytic enzyme. Without it the tail cannot beat.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of four. The start that anchors it is not in the crystal.
structure.semantics: One chain of the sperm's glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase tetramer, solved by X-ray at 1.72 Å with NAD. 334 of its 408 residues are placed: the proline-rich start that ties it to the tail's fibrous sheath is not in the crystal. The NAD and the other three chains are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Smells bacteria: it makes a neutrophil follow formyl peptides to the source.

structure.label: the receptor
structure.sentence: Seven helices across the membrane; the peptide it senses is not drawn.
structure.semantics: FPR1, solved by cryo-EM at 2.8 Å bound to the peptide fMIFL and a G protein: seven helices across the membrane, held by one disulfide bridge. 295 of its 350 residues are placed. The peptide, the G protein's three chains and the antibody fragment holding them are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Makes the adrenal's sex steroids. Abiraterone blocks it in prostate cancer.

structure.label: the enzyme
structure.sentence: Two steps of steroid synthesis happen here. Its heme is not drawn.
structure.semantics: CYP17A1, solved by X-ray at 2.01 Å with its heme and an abiraterone analogue bound. 464 of its 508 residues are placed; the membrane anchor at the start, residues 1 to 30, is not in the crystal. The heme and the analogue are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Adds the glucuronic acid the HNK-1 mark on nerve surfaces is built on.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of two. The stalk and membrane anchor are not drawn.
structure.semantics: One chain of the GlcAT-P dimer, solved by X-ray at 1.82 Å with UDP, manganese and the sugar it acts on. 245 of its 334 residues are placed: the stalk and membrane anchor, residues 1 to 82, are not in the crystal. The ligands and the other chain are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Meiosis only: it finds the matching chromosome and swaps strands with it.

structure.label: the recombinase
structure.sentence: One chain of the filament it builds on DNA; the DNA is not drawn.
structure.semantics: One DMC1 chain from a filament on single-stranded DNA, solved by cryo-EM at 3.3 Å. 308 of its 340 residues are placed. The DNA, the other two chains and the bound nucleotide are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Pinches off the vesicle: it wraps the neck and cuts it, using GTP.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the ring it winds round a vesicle's neck.
structure.semantics: One dynamin-1 chain from the polymer wound round a membrane neck, caught in its constricted state and solved by cryo-EM at 3.3 Å. 693 of its 864 residues are placed. The membrane, the bound GDP and the other three chains are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Held at the synapse by ADAM22. Autoantibodies to it cause encephalitis.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of three, as it binds ADAM22; its partner is not drawn.
structure.semantics: One LGI1 chain from the 3:3 complex it forms with ADAM22, solved by cryo-EM at 3.8 Å: a horseshoe of leucine-rich repeats and the EPTP propeller, with the five disulfide bridges the entry places. 511 of the 523 residues after the signal peptide are placed. The three ADAM22 chains and the other two LGI1 chains are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: A calcium sensor of the urothelium; a marker of bladder and pancreatic cancers.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the calcium-bound pair, with its two EF-hands.
structure.semantics: One S100P chain from its calcium-bound homodimer, solved by X-ray at 2.0 Å: two EF-hands. 88 of its 95 residues are placed; the hinge between the hands, 46 to 51, and the last residue are not. The other chain and the calcium are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Turns β1,4-galactosyltransferase into lactose synthase, the enzyme of milk sugar.

structure.label: the fold
structure.sentence: The calcium-bound fold, held by four disulfide bridges.
structure.semantics: Human alpha-lactalbumin, solved by X-ray at 1.61 Å with calcium bound: one of the crystal's two copies. 119 of the 123 residues after the signal peptide are placed, and its four disulfide bridges are drawn. The calcium is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Blocks neutrophil elastase on mucosal surfaces; plentiful in cervical mucus.

structure.label: the second WAP domain
structure.sentence: The second of its two WAP domains, which carries the inhibitory loop.
structure.semantics: The second WAP domain of SLPI, residues 85 to 131, as it binds porcine trypsin, solved by X-ray at 2.0 Å. Every residue is placed, and its four disulfide bridges are drawn. The first half of the chain, with the other WAP domain, and the trypsin are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Hands cholesterol to NPC1 in the lysosome. Losing it causes Niemann–Pick C2.

structure.label: the fold
structure.sentence: Solved with cholesterol sulfate in its pocket, bound to NPC1; neither is drawn.
structure.semantics: NPC2, residues 20 to 151, from its complex with the middle lumenal domain of NPC1, solved by X-ray at 2.4 Å with cholesterol sulfate in its pocket. Every residue is placed, and its three disulfide bridges are drawn. NPC1, the entry's second pair and the cholesterol sulfate are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: After a meal it tells the liver, through β-Klotho, to make less bile acid.

structure.label: the fold
structure.sentence: Its β-trefoil core. 136 of the 194 residues are placed; the ends are not.
structure.semantics: FGF19, solved by X-ray at 1.8 Å: one chain of the crystal's two, its β-trefoil core placed from residue 40 to 175, 136 of the 194 residues after the signal peptide. The bridge 102–120 is drawn; 58–70, which UniProt also annotates, is open in this crystal, its sulfurs 2.7 Å apart, and is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Ferries bile acids across the cells of the ileum, on their way back to the liver.

structure.label: the fold
structure.sentence: A β-barrel with a helical lid, solved with cholate inside it.
structure.semantics: FABP6, residues 2 to 128, solved by X-ray at 2.39 Å: the one of the crystal's three chains that holds cholate. 125 of its 127 residues are placed. The cholate and the other two chains are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: A collectin of the airways: its heads bind microbial sugars and clump the microbes.

structure.label: the C-type lectin domain
structure.sentence: One sugar-binding head of the trimer; its stalk is not drawn.
structure.semantics: The C-type lectin domain of SP-D and the ten residues before it, 250 to 375, from one chain of a trimeric fragment solved by X-ray at 1.4 Å with maltose. Every residue is placed, and its two disulfide bridges are drawn. The other two heads, the neck, the collagen stalk, the calcium and the maltose are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Of the egg's subcortical maternal complex; without it, embryos arrest early.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the pair: a deiminase's fold, without a deiminase's activity.
structure.semantics: One PADI6 chain from its homodimer, solved by cryo-EM at 2.8 Å. 685 of its 694 residues are placed; the first nine are not. The other chain is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Senses blood calcium and turns PTH release down. Calcimimetics act through it.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the active dimer, from the Venus flytrap to the seven helices.
structure.semantics: One CaSR chain from the active homodimer, solved by cryo-EM at 2.5 Å with calcium, tryptophan and two calcimimetics bound: from the Venus flytrap to the seven helices, 821 of the 1,059 residues after the signal peptide. Eight disulfide bridges are drawn; 437–449, open in this chain, is not. The other chain, the ligands and the tail inside the cell are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: A main enzyme of semen. It was the marker of prostate cancer before PSA.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the dimer, as purified from human semen.
structure.semantics: One chain of prostatic acid phosphatase from its homodimer, purified from human semen and solved by cryo-EM at 3.2 Å. 345 of the 354 residues after the signal peptide are placed, and its two disulfide bridges are drawn. The other chain and the sugars are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: The TIE2 agonist that keeps blood vessels stable and their lining sealed.

structure.label: the receptor-binding domain
structure.sentence: Its receptor-binding domain, the part that binds TIE2.
structure.semantics: The receptor-binding domain of angiopoietin-1, residues 283 to 498, solved by X-ray at 1.75 Å. Every residue is placed, and its three disulfide bridges are drawn, 435–437 among them, which UniProt does not annotate. The rest of the chain is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Cross-links collagen and elastin outside the cell. A target in fibrosis and cancer.

structure.label: the third and fourth SRCR domains
structure.sentence: Its third and fourth SRCR domains. The rest of the chain is not drawn.
structure.semantics: The third and fourth SRCR domains of LOXL2, residues 322 to 554, from a crystal of the precursor at 2.4 Å. Every residue is placed, and five disulfide bridges are drawn; UniProt's sixth here, 351–414, is not named by the entry and is not drawn. The rest of the chain, the metals and the sugars are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Makes phosphocreatine in muscle mitochondria, the store that keeps ATP topped up.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One of the crystal's eight chains, solved with ADP.
structure.semantics: One CKMT2 chain, solved by X-ray at 2.1 Å with ADP bound: one of the crystal's eight. 369 of the 380 residues after the transit peptide are placed. The other chains and the ADP are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: The endometrium's main secretion after ovulation. Its glycans set what it does.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the dimer: a lipocalin barrel.
structure.semantics: One glycodelin chain from its dimer, solved by X-ray at 2.45 Å: a lipocalin barrel. 153 of the 162 residues after the signal peptide are placed, and its two disulfide bridges are drawn. The entry has Glu at 46, where the gene makes an Asn that carries a glycan. The other chain is not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Oxygenates arachidonic acid to 12-HETE, in platelets and squamous epithelia.

structure.label: the subunit
structure.sentence: One chain of the tetramer: a PLAT domain and the catalytic domain.
structure.semantics: One ALOX12 chain from its tetramer, solved by cryo-EM at 2.0 Å: a PLAT domain and the catalytic domain that holds the iron. 662 of its 663 residues are placed. The entry has Ser at 322, where the record has Asn. The other three chains, the iron and the oleoyl-CoA this chain binds are not drawn. Drag to turn it.

proteins.summary: Tethers dying cells' phosphatidylserine to AXL and MERTK; vitamin K-dependent.

structure.label: the laminin G-like domains
structure.sentence: Its two laminin G-like domains, which bind AXL. The rest is not drawn.
structure.semantics: The two laminin G-like domains of GAS6, residues 288 to 675, bound to the AXL receptor and solved by X-ray at 2.3 Å. 369 of these 388 residues are placed, and their two disulfide bridges are drawn. The Gla and EGF-like domains, AXL and the calcium are not drawn. Drag to turn it.
